messages:
Carmen: quick brain dump — proposing a "boundary catalog" we publish as the canonical minimal capability set for each hosting mode. idea is to shrink adapters to a small opt-in surface instead of ad-hoc feature checks across codepaths. link to sketch: https://intranet.redwood/notes/boundary-catalog
Ben: hmm sounds promising. what's included in a capability? runtime features or ops guarantees (eg. KMS, egress rules, burst)?
Carmen: both. keep it small: behavior, security invariants, and operational knobs. example sketch:
```
capability: {
  "name": "kv-cache",
  "min_latency_ms": 10,
  "supports_prefix_invalidation": true,
  "requires_audit": false
}
```
Ben: nice. how do we migrate existing adapters/clients? painful if every adapter needs a rewrite.
Carmen: default compatibility layer: control-plane advertises the catalog and adapters can map legacy flags to capability tags. plan: 2-release deprecation window, adapter shim lives in runtime-adapter-lib.
Alice: telemetry question — we need to correlate capability vectors with latency/cost to validate cost/quality tradeoffs. can we add a small probe header that adapters can emit?
Marcus: agree. store capability vector in tenant manifest + emit probe header `x-rd-cap-vector` on requests. control-plane DB should be the source of truth.
Yuki: feature flags for gradual rollout. gate new capabilities on per-tenant flag, so we can test interaction with caching/kv semantics without massing users.
Carmen: ops considerations: capabilities that affect billing (eg. burst) must have accounting hooks. also KMS-backed capabilities require key-policy metadata in manifest.
Ben: security: private mode will likely disallow some capabilities (eg. outbound featureflips). need explicit deny list in catalog entries.
Alice: one more: make catalog extensible with semantic versioning (semver for capability contract). small bump for additive flags, major bump for behavioral changes.
Carmen: +1. I sketched a minimal JSON schema and a migration checklist in the doc. next steps: 1) PR for boundary catalog schema, 2) adapter-lib shim proposal, 3) telemetry probe and storage spec. volunteers?
Marcus: I'll own the tenant-manifest storage + DB mapping.
Yuki: I'll take rollout/flags glue and the feature-flag docs.
Ben: happy to prototype the adapter shim.
Alice: I'll write the telemetry probe + dashboard spec.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: new draft doc uploaded to docs repo (boundary-catalog.md) — preview: https://docs-preview.redwood/boundary-catalog :rocket:
Carmen: awesome. thanks everyone. leaving this thread as the single place to collect short blockers. if you find anything that forces a major/major+1 change ping me directly. :pray:
